about.label: About
about.title: The person behind the terminal
about.lead: I'm Kharis — an IT and network engineer in Indonesia who fell in love with the web somewhere between the third rack mount and the first production incident.
about.p1: By trade I keep networks alive: cabling, configuration, monitoring, and the occasional 2 a.m. phone call from someone whose printer is 'suddenly broken' (it's never the printer). By hobby — which became a second job — I build software: dashboards, storefronts, bots, and the odd AI sidekick.
about.p2: I like systems that are quiet on the outside and well-organized on the inside. Cable ties in the rack, clean commits in the repo. Most of what I've learned came from breaking things at home first, so they don't break at work.
